Updated: 12:35 PM CDT Apr 15, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Today will be another warm day with mostly dry conditions. Clouds will gradually increase throughout the day with highs 81-85 degrees. There is a chance for spotty showers, but most areas will end up staying dry! If rain does occur, it will likely happen in the afternoon and evening. Lows tonight will fall back to the 60s. Thursday is almost a repeat of today with highs in the mid 80s with a few spotty showers possible, but it does appear most places will end up staying dry. Highs Friday and Saturday could creep to the mid to upper 80s! A cold front will move early Sunday morning, bringing a few showers along with it. The timing of it looks to be early Sunday morning, moving out before 9 a.m. This front will bring in some cooler air, so highs Sunday will only be in the 70s.
